body: Market lens: ang mas importanteng signal dito is whether maintenance AI becomes repeatable software/service revenue rather than a one-off factory demo. If customers can deploy it across mixed legacy equipment without heavy integration, the value chain broadens beyond robot makers toward sensors, industrial software and service contracts. Until field economics appear, though, this is a capability signal—not yet an earnings thesis.

For markets, the interesting part comes after the subsidy, not during it. Kapag nawala ang temporary bill cushion, headline household inflation can look firmer even without a fresh energy shock, while disposable-income pressure can rise. That makes the October transition worth separating from underlying commodity moves before interpreting inflation or consumption data.

Market caution: manufacturer repricing counts are useful inflation-pressure evidence, pero hindi sila automatic BOJ-hike signal. The transmission test is whether these increases survive retail discounting, lift official food inflation, and outpace wages enough to alter consumption. If wage growth absorbs more of the shock, the same price data can imply a very different macro outcome.
